entities.summary: Fanny Victoria Camia Rask is a Swedish ice hockey forward and member of the Swedish national team, currently playing in the Swiss Women's League with HC Ambrì-Piotta Girls. She has represented Sweden in over 100 international matches, including the Winter Olympic Games in the 2014 and 2018 as well as at three IIHF Women's World Championships.
